evidence.observation: Official current page states charging via ladenetz.de ladeapp without a charging card at all Stadtwerke Weimar stations: AC 0.52 EUR/kWh plus 0.10 EUR/min from 240 minutes, capped at 12 EUR/session; DC 0.60 EUR/kWh plus 0.10 EUR/min from 90 minutes, capped at 12 EUR/session.

stadtwerke_weimar.reason: Current official direct/no-card tariff and blocking rules are explicit and scoped to Stadtwerke Weimar stations.

evidence.observation: Official current page confirms SÜC operates a mixed AC/DC/HPC public network and promotes the SÜC charging card, but does not publish a current direct/ad-hoc tariff matrix.
Official tariff PDF is explicitly for SÜC E-Ladekarteninhaber and therefore cannot be promoted as ad-hoc/direct pricing.

A current SÜC site exposes direct card payment and differing station-level DC prices (including 0.60 and 0.65 EUR/kWh), demonstrating that a single cardholder tariff cannot safely substitute for direct pricing. Discovery evidence only; not promoted.

suec_coburg.reason: Official material only proves the card product, while current station-level direct prices vary. No official exhaustive EVSE-to-direct-price mapping was found.
suec_coburg.neededToComplete: Resolve SÜC public card-terminal/QR checkout or an official AFIR/Mobilithek tariff feed per EVSE and preserve power-tier/site-specific prices and blocking rules.

evidence.observation: Current discovery source identifies a RhönEnergie Fulda Gelegenheits-Lader card tariff of 0.51 EUR/kWh AC and 0.61 EUR/kWh DC/HPC. This is a card tariff and is not promoted as ad-hoc.
A 2026 RhönEnergie Fulda HPC site exposes NFC credit/debit card and online payment methods, confirming direct-payment-capable infrastructure, but the page does not publish the exact direct tariff.

A third-party current page reports one RhönEnergie location at 0.49 EUR/kWh AC and 0.64 EUR/kWh DC with blocking fees, conflicting with the provider card tariff and demonstrating that values cannot be generalized. Discovery evidence only; not promoted.

rhoenenergie_fulda.reason: Direct-payment capability is evidenced at current RhönEnergie sites, but no current official station/EVSE direct price matrix was found and third-party prices conflict with card-product pricing.
rhoenenergie_fulda.neededToComplete: Obtain RhönEnergie's official direct-payment checkout or official AFIR/Mobilithek/DATEX tariff payload keyed by EVSE/site, including blocking rules.
